texts:
Week 5 handed touchdowns to backs about to lose their jobs and quiet days to players whose roles never moved. These are the buys and the sells, with a price on each.

Best buy: Chase Brown on his bye.
Let's get into it.
#WhoDey

Chase Brown, CIN RB: still out-snapped Samaje Perine 38 to 33 @MIA, but has 22 carries for 49 over two games, and Cincinnati is on bye.
RB6 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer an RB2 and a WR3.
#WhoDey

Bhayshul Tuten, JAX RB: 22 carries vs PHI and 87.5 percent of the early downs, up from 71 percent.
RB18 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR3 and a bench back.
#DUUUVAL

Chris Olave, NO WR: 13, 10 and 13 targets in Weeks 1 to 3, then 4 of 6 for 46 with Tyler Shough's hand wrapped. One quiet game is the discount.
WR7 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR2.
#Saints

Trey McBride, ARI TE: 10 or more targets in each of his first four games, 2 TDs.
TE2 rest of season for me. Offer a WR2.

Michael Wilson, ARI WR: 51 targets in five games, and Harrison is gone.
WR40 rest of season for me. Offer a bench receiver.
#BirdGang

DJ Moore, BUF WR: a team-high 10 targets in Week 3, then sat Monday with an AC joint sprain that is not long term.
WR23 rest of season for me. Trade for him while he sits; offer a bench WR3.
#BillsMafia

Kyren Williams, LAR RB: 70 snaps to Blake Corum's 13 in Week 4 and 8 targets Monday night, but only 49 yards on 16 carries.
RB12 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR3 and a bench RB.
#RamsHouse

Rashee Rice, KC WR: targets went 2, 6, 9 before the hamstring, and Tyquan Thornton is out 12 to 16 weeks.
WR20 rest of season for me. Trade for him before he practices; offer a WR3.
#ChiefsKingdom

Colston Loveland, CHI TE: 9 targets in Week 4 with Tyson Bagent, as many as Weeks 1 to 3 combined. Caleb Williams is on track to practice Wednesday.
TE4 rest of season for me. Offer a TE in the 10 to 14 range and a bench WR.
#DaBears

Lamar Jackson, BAL QB: sat Week 5 with the ankle and has a real chance to play @CLE.
QB2 rest of season for me. Trade for him before Wednesday's practice report; offer a WR2.
#RavensFlock

Mike Evans, SF WR: 10 targets, 7 for 113 and a TD @SEA on two broken ribs, and Deebo Samuel Sr. is out a few weeks.
WR26 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR3.
#FTTB

Malik Nabers, NYG WR: 20 targets @WAS on 90 percent of the snaps, 11 for 121 and a TD.
WR14 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR2.
#NYGiants

Aaron Jones Sr., MIN RB: a season-high 87 percent of the snaps @NO, 25 carries for 113 and a TD. Minnesota is on bye.
RB32 rest of season for me. Trade for him during the bye; offer a bench RB.
#Skol

Now the sells.

Jaylen Warren, PIT RB: 87 percent of the snaps and 490 scrimmage yards over three weeks, all with Rico Dowdle out. Dowdle is expected back.
RB23 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for an RB2.
#HereWeGo

Aaron Rodgers, PIT QB: three straight 3-TD games, but 22-point weeks, with 235 yards vs IND and three receivers down.
QB29 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a bench RB.
#HereWeGo

Braelon Allen, NYJ RB: 24 carries for 116 and a TD vs CLE with Breece Hall out. The job goes back to Hall when he is healthy.
RB49 rest of season for me. Trade him away after this week; ask for a WR3 with a full-time role.
#JetUp

Javonte Williams, DAL RB: 74 carries at about 3.7 a carry, and Dallas ran for 50 vs TB.
RB11 rest of season for me. Ask for a WR2.

Jake Ferguson, DAL TE: 3 TDs on 11 targets in Weeks 1 to 3, then 3 of 6 for 19.
TE17 rest of season for me. Ask for a bench WR.
#DallasCowboys

Davante Adams, LAR WR: 2 TDs on 7 targets vs BUF while Puka Nacua drew 24. He had 13 targets in Week 3 with Nacua out.
WR25 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a WR2.
#RamsHouse

Jaylen Waddle, DEN WR: 10 catches for 66 yards in the four games outside Week 2.
WR15 rest of season for me, and his name sells for more than his role. Trade him away; ask for a WR3 who gets targets.
#BroncosCountry

Emanuel Wilson, SEA RB: 41 carries in two games with Jadarian Price on IR, 3.1 a carry in Week 5. Zach Charbonnet's activation is close.
RB59 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a bench WR with a full-time role.
#Seahawks

Tony Pollard, TEN RB: Tyjae Spears out-snapped him 34 to 30 vs HOU and caught all 9 targets.
RB30 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a WR3.
#TitanUp

Brian Thomas Jr., JAX WR: 0 catches on 3 targets vs PHI while Parker Washington drew 9. He leaves the field in 12 personnel.
WR42 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a WR3.
#DUUUVAL

Justin Herbert, LAC QB: 121 passing yards vs DEN, no 15-point game in five tries, one September starter left on the line.
QB16 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a bench WR and a streaming QB.
#BoltUp

The one trade to make today: Chase Brown while Cincinnati sits on bye and his manager stares at 22 carries for 49.

Offer an RB2 and a WR3.
#WhoDey

Every buy and sell with its price is on the site. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the rest of the week's calls, and repost this for your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/butcher.html?week=6
